label: Aurora

county_election_office.name: Arapahoe County Elections (most of Aurora); Adams County Elections (north Aurora); Douglas County Elections (far southeast Aurora). Your ballot comes from the county you live in.
county_election_office.phone: Arapahoe Clerk and Recorder 303-795-4200; Adams County Elections 720-523-6500; Douglas County Elections 303-660-7444

zip_caveats: Aurora spans three counties, and the county decides which county races, judges and 7A status you see. Roughly: ZIPs 80010, 80011, 80019, 80045 and parts of 80012/80017 straddle the Arapahoe and Adams line (north of about Colfax or I-70 is Adams); 80016 and 80015 reach into Douglas County near Southlands; 80247 is split between Aurora and Denver; 80014 and 80231 include unincorporated Arapahoe and Denver pockets. Congressional district is mostly CD-6, but parts of north Aurora in Adams County are CD-8, and a small piece near Lowry is CD-1. Aurora's city measures 3A to 3D appear on every Aurora ballot regardless of county. Front Range rail 7A: Aurora is NOT in the rail district, but Arapahoe, Adams and Douglas ballots wrongly printed 7A for many voters; state guidance is to vote your ballot as is and clerks will set aside ineligible 7A votes.
